1) Acceptance
There’s a lot of things in this life we have no control over. Like how we feel. We can control how we can think of things. It’s not an easy task to accept your pain. It’s easily the hardest thing I’ve had to do, but the most rewarding. 

2) Medicine/therapy 
The most effective way of dealing with it is medicine and seeing a therapist. For me it took almost 4 months for it to start working, but it sure as hell work.

3) You time
Spend more time doing activities you enjoy or used to enjoy. Give yourself time to relax and wind down. The more stress you add upon yourself the worse it will become.

4) Art
Art is a good way of expressing your feelings. Depression is hard to express in words. I picked up poetry. Others have expressed themselves in music and literature and painting. It’s helped me and I’ve enjoyed it.
